title: Represent XOR and disprove affine separation
promptMarkdown: On inputs(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1), labels are0,1,1,0. Construct a two-hidden-unit ReLU network whose scalar output equals these labels exactly. Prove that no affine score with prediction1 for score>0 and0 for score≤0 can classify all four correctly. Count parameters in a fully connected2→2→1 architecture including biases, even if your construction fixes some to zero.
hintLadder: Try a function of s=x1+x2 with a peak at s=1.
Add the two strict positive inequalities.
Count all free architecture parameters separately from chosen construction values.
